commands.stdout:
usage: olyder [-h] [--version]
              {doctor,bench,reconcile,prune,status,resume,cancel,report,serve,init,plan,idea,verify,run,install-skill,mcp}
              ...

Independent verification and bounded AI repair loops

positional arguments:
  {doctor,bench,reconcile,prune,status,resume,cancel,report,serve,init,plan,idea,verify,run,install-skill,mcp}
    doctor              Read-only setup and capability diagnostics
    bench               Run offline paired executable fixtures; never calls
                        paid agents
    reconcile           Record an explicit user-provided billing receipt
    prune               List expired completed run artifacts; deletion needs
                        --apply
    serve               Optional authenticated loopback read API
    init                Generate a starter acceptance specification
    install-skill       Install agent SKILL.md into a project
    mcp                 Run read-only-by-default MCP JSON-RPC server over
                        stdio

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
